author: Onebrief
body:
What a week at CascadiaJS.

A huge thank you to the CascadiaJS team for putting on such a fantastic event and to everyone who stopped by our booth, attended Jeff Otaño's lightning talk, or connected with us at the networking mixer. It was great to connect with so many thoughtful, curious engineers and sharing what we're building at Onebrief.

A few moments that stuck with us:
⚡Jeff's talk on building AI platforms engineers actually trust sparked some great conversations with people tackling similar challenges in their own organizations
🤖 Great conversations about how teams are using AI and how we’re applying it across our product and engineering organization
🕺 One attendee even brought over a dancing robot they'd built as a side project. It may have been one of the coolest things we saw all week

If we met you in Seattle, or if the conversations above sound interesting to you, we're hiring. Check out our open roles in the comments.

#LifeAtOnebrief
